description: This file defines the routes for authentication-related endpoints in a Node.js/Express backend, including user registration, login, logout, current user info, and protected endpoints with role-based access control.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, validating input and delegating to authController.register

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, validating credentials and delegating to authController.login

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, delegating to authController.logout

methods.name: me
methods.description: Returns current authenticated user info, delegating to authController.me
